questions.q: Which demon lord is Raven's father?
questions.why: Raven's father is Trigon, a demon lord, and her mother is a human named Arella.

questions.q: What is the name of Raven's mystical homeland dimension?
questions.why: Raven comes from Azarath, the realm where her mother Arella sought refuge.
Raven was created for the New Teen Titans by Marv Wolfman (writer) and George Pérez (artist).

questions.q: In which year did Raven first appear, in a preview insert that launched the New Teen Titans?
questions.why: DC Comics Presents #26 (October 1980) carried her first appearance, in a special insert.

questions.q: What is the name of Raven's mother?
questions.why: Arella is a human woman whose union with a demon lord produced Raven.

questions.q: What colour is Raven's astral 'Soul Self'?
questions.why: George Pérez drew the Soul Self in solid black, so it reads as a gigantic raven.

questions.q: Who voices Raven in the animated series Teen Titans and Teen Titans Go!?
questions.why: Tara Strong has voiced Raven in both cartoons.

questions.q: Which actress plays Rachel Roth, Raven, in the live-action series Titans?
questions.why: Teagan Croft plays the teenage Raven in Titans.

questions.q: Which actress voices Raven in the DC Animated Movie Universe films?
questions.why: Taissa Farmiga took over the role for the DC animated movie line.

questions.q: Which of these supernatural teams has Raven belonged to in the comics?
questions.why: Besides the Titans and Justice League, Raven has been tied to groups such as Justice League Dark, Sentinels of Magic and Night Force.
